timeline.title: Tornfolio
timeline.summary: Upkeep history now stays compact without a horizontal scrollbar, while the short table can vertically scroll through every retained payment. Tornfolio 0.8.9 also saves payments by account, property and event ID for cross-device sync, and migrates Torn PDA data to the app's native per-script storage to prevent localStorage quota loops.

timeline.title: Tornfolio
timeline.summary: Tornfolio now keeps Torn's Recent upkeep payments locally and reports payer totals, payment days, daily cost, days covered, and a 50/50 balance for two residents. Version 0.8.8 also keeps the modal history in a compact, internally scrollable table so longer payment histories stay inside the dialog.

timeline.title: cRaCked

timeline.title: cRaCked

timeline.title: cRaCked

timeline.title: cRaCked

TornPDA retains its API fallback when embedded account data is unavailable…

timeline.title: cRaCked

timeline.title: cRaCked
timeline.summary: cRaCked 2.4.1 — safe one-shot modifier actions — A modifier-click sends at most one suggested character and waits for Torn's verdict before another action can run. Duplicate miss notifications are collapsed instead of consuming the script's whole guess budget on screen…

timeline.title: cRaCked
